messages:
devon: heads up — after the route-policy tweak at 08:14 tenant 'acme-corp' traces show root spans but almost no child spans. looks limited to requests that hit router-v2 -> kafka-exporter path. sample trace: 3b9f1a2e...

maria: ugh. is it every trace for that tenant or intermittent? any error logs from exporter?

devon: almost every trace for that tenant during the deploy window. exporter logs show normal accepts, but the collector log that receives router output has lines like: 
```
2026-03-10T08:15:12Z WARN header_sanitize: removed headers >1024 bytes from incoming request
2026-03-10T08:15:12Z DEBUG inbound: headers after sanitize: [host, content-type, cookie, x-some-meta]
```
router seems to report traceparent in ingress, but downstream the header is missing.

kevin: can you paste raw ingress headers for a failing request? also try `curl -v` against the router debug endpoint to confirm.

devon: pasted a shortened dump: 
```
:method: POST
:scheme: https
host: api.redwood.dev
traceparent: 00-3b9f1a2e...-01
cookie: session=LONGBASE64...verylong...; other=val
x-forwarded-for: 10.2.1.4
```
after sanitizer: 
```
:method: POST
:scheme: https
host: api.redwood.dev
cookie: session=TRIMMED
x-forwarded-for: 10.2.1.4
```
traceparent gone.

aj: we saw intermittent exporter 429s around 08:12 which triggered backoff, but that would cause buffering/retry. it wouldn't strip headers. header removal smells like the new route-policy header-trim rule in PR 2129 (kevin added).

kevin: yeah that was the change — we added a generic header size sanitizer to protect downstream (limit 1024 bytes per header). it runs in router-v2 before forwarding. i didn't realize it could drop specific headers entirely vs truncating. config looks like: 
```
header_sanitize:
  max_header_bytes: 1024
  action: remove_if_exceeds
  preserve_prefixes: []
```
we defaulted preserve_prefixes empty. traceparent is short but in this tenant the cookie pushes header map size over threshold and the implementation picks headers to remove by alphabetical order (buggy).

maria: ack. so the sanitizer removed traceparent because selection logic is nondeterministic. that explains why only tenants with massive cookies triggered it.

devon: can we quickfix to preserve traceparent explicitly? or rollback the sanitizer?

kevin: i'll push a quick patch to preserve traceparent and set preserve_prefixes: ["traceparent", "tracestate"] — but that's risky in prod; safer to rollback the header-sanitize action to noop until we have deterministic evict.

maria: agree rollback for canary + prod for now. canary in dev, then prod.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for route-policy v2 at 2026-03-10T08:28:40Z by kevin. change-id: rp-2129-rollback.

devon: monitoring traces in the tenant dashboard now — pouring in older child spans for sample trace 3b9f1a2e... :eyes:

otel-bot: notice: kafka-exporter-3 restarted at 2026-03-10T08:29:05Z (reconcile), no errors reported post-rollback.

maria: confirmed: child spans reappearing across three test traces for acme-corp. looks good.

aj: open follow-up: make header sanitizer respect preserve list and add unit + integration tests to ensure trace headers never get evicted. also add a metric that counts dropped-critical-headers. i'll file an issue.

kevin: created issue #3346: "header-sanitize: deterministic eviction and preserve trace headers". assigning to kevin+devon. planned fix: change eviction to LRU by header size and honor preserve_prefixes by prefix match.

devon: thanks all. next steps: monitor for 30m, roll forward small canary when tested, and include a note in postmortem. i'll start a short incident note. :thumbsup:

maria: adding timeline + signal screenshots to the issue.

kevin: will send PR for preserve_prefixes ASAP, not merging until tests and load bench.

devon: closing out here once 30m clean. great fast response team.

(emoji reactions: :eyes: on otel-bot line, :white_check_mark: on rollback line)
